tenderSchedule.description: Supply of drivers, encroachment removal labours & cremation ground watchman to City Corporation Belagavi (On outsource contract basis)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have experience in providing Manpower Services of drivers / watchman /labour /security guards to Government Offices and Government Boards & ULBs a minimum of 38 (80% of total manpower) number of related manpower for the minimum period of one year in any of last three financial years.
Registration of firm / establishment under Labour Dept., GOK

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration of firm or establishment

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Registration Certificate under Employees State Insurance Act (ESI ACT). Previous years statements yearly returns submitted to Employee State Insurance (ESI) authorities (upload last 3 years, year wise ESI returns details). Agencies with proof of over Rs 5.40 lakhs return to ESI in any one year in last three years only need apply

Employee Provident Fund Registration Certificate issued by the Regional Provident Fund (Upload last 3 years, year wise statement of yearly returns submitted to PF authorities.). Agencies with proof of payment over Rs.34.00 Lakhs return to PF in any one year in last three years only need apply
GST registration certificate and return file for the last 3 years to be uploaded. (i.e. FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)

The Agency should have total turnover of at least Rs. 139 Lakhs in any one year in last three years. The Agencies should submit proof of Audited Annual Turnover Certificate, Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Accounts, Income and Expenditure Accounts and IT return (UDIN number is mandatory)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.41.70 Lakhs (Unconditional Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from Nationalized/Scheduled banks for meeting the fund requirement. (As per format attached in KPP Portal)
